categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, production, and sales of biochemical compound fertilizers, combining organic matter, microorganisms, and chemical raw materials. Secondary business segments include chemical fertilizers, various microbial products, and health supplements. The products mainly serve crops such as oil palm, rubber, and rice, with a focus on the Malaysian market.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biotechnology to develop biochemical compound fertilizers integrating organic, microbial, and chemical components. Key technologies include microbial strain selection, fermentation, bio-stabilization to protect microbes from chemical damage, and granulation processes. The company also develops bio-control agents against plant diseases and employs proprietary microbial formulations to enhance soil health and crop resistance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large-scale plantations, government-affiliated companies, private agricultural enterprises, distributors, and smallholder farmers mainly in Malaysia. The products target oil palm plantations predominantly, with expansion into other crops like rubber and rice. The company also serves markets in Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore, and Taiwan, focusing on Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Malaysia, with production and sales subsidiaries in Indonesia, Vietnam, Singapore, Brunei, and Taiwan. It plans to expand further into ASEAN countries such as Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, the Philippines, South Korea, and Japan, with long-term goals to enter Middle Eastern and European markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a fertilizer manufacturer, sourcing chemical, organic, and microbial raw materials upstream and supplying finished biochemical compound fertilizers downstream to plantations and distributors. It also engages in microbial research and bio-vaccine production, integrating upstream R&D with midstream manufacturing and downstream sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing green agriculture, expanding production capacity especially in Indonesia, and developing multifunctional, environmentally friendly fertilizers with disease control properties. R&D focuses on microbial strain development, bio-control agents, soil improvement technologies, and recycling agricultural by-products. The company also invests in health supplements and bio-vaccine products, aiming for sustainable agriculture and circular economy initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of biochemical compound fertilizers, chemical fertilizers, microbial products, and health supplements. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with large plantations, distributors, and retail channels. The company also benefits from licensing agreements and government collaborations for specialized fertilizer formulations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the Malaysian biochemical compound fertilizer market, distinguished by proprietary bio-stabilization technology and government certifications. Competitors mainly produce chemical fertilizers with lower technological barriers. The company’s integration of microbial and organic components with chemical fertilizers creates a high entry barrier and competitive advantage in multifunctional fertilizers and disease control.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$2.46 billion, a 13% decrease from the previous year, with net profit after tax of NT$128.6 million. The company maintains a stable financial structure with low debt ratios and positive equity growth. It has invested in expanding production facilities, especially in Indonesia, and continues to grow its R&D capabilities. The company’s market share in Malaysia’s fertilizer market is about 2.74%, with steady expansion plans.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique biochemical compound fertilizers that combine organic matter, beneficial microbes, and chemical nutrients to improve soil health, increase crop yield, and provide disease resistance, notably against oil palm basal stem rot. Its patented bio-stabilization technology protects microbes within fertilizers, enhancing efficacy. The company also offers customized solutions, strong technical support, and sustainable agricultural products aligned with environmental protection and circular economy principles.
